pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_20: The skin of the enderpuff slowly defuses through your
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_19: bare hands and its blood starts to combine with yours.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_18: As the blood mixes with yours, a dangerous parasite living
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_17: inside the enderpuff's blood does so as well.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_16: You start to feel a light ticklish sensation on your skin
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_15: and before you can act the pufferfish creeps up your arm,
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_14: onto your head and can't be removed anymore.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_13: Your vocal cords will stop functioning and all you can say
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_12: from now on is splash and puff.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_11: Your friends won't recognize you anymore.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_10: Your family won't recognize your anymore.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_9: Your dog won't recognize you anymore.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_8: As the transformation continues you will slowly lose
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_7: control over your arms, legs, and other important organs.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_6: But you'll be ready to be adopted by them.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_5: They will treat you like their own kind.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_3: They will start to milk your freshly grown poison glands
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_2: and enjoy the gooey poison syrup in excessive feasts.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_1: Soon you'll be able to see what they see.
pc.text.enderpuff_lore.text_0: I was cursed to read this and now so are you

pc.text.how_to_play.title: Welcome to the Masquerade!
pc.text.how_to_play.body:
Get ready for a night of social deduction! A demon has been unleashed on the party, can the good team find and execute them before they all fall?

Chat is restricted! Use the Quill in your hotbar to discuss with players nearby.

Don your mask. Every player is anonymous during the game and will play a special role with powerful abilities.

Enough reading! The best way to learn is by playing a few games, so launch masquerade.exe and dive in!
pc.text.pigeon.title: AN ODE TO PIGEON
pc.text.pigeon.text_1: Oh Pigeon, oh postman, oh keeper of mail,
pc.text.pigeon.text_2: Your satchel was full, your wings set to sail.
pc.text.pigeon.text_3: But Pig or Pigeon, it was never clear,
pc.text.pigeon.text_4: And Parrot's name crept far too near.
pc.text.pigeon.text_5: Yes, you caused quite the confusion,
pc.text.pigeon.text_6: And so removal remained the only conclusion.
pc.text.pigeon.text_7: We're sorry, dear Pigeon, it's nothing you did,
pc.text.pigeon.text_8: You just got lost in the names yours hid.
pc.text.pigeon.text_9: So rest now, our carrier of post,

ww.generic.welcome_page:
Welcome to The Masquerade,
a social deduction game inspired by %s.

This game takes some learning, so expect to play a few games before you fully get the hang of it.

Please log into the courtyard computer to get started.

it will be stored in your Logbook.

Being Confused will make this information false!
ww.generic.info_text.5:

ww.hint.task_find: Clue found! Stay in the room to collect it.
ww.hint.task_complete: First Clue collected! You need 3 more to accuse someone, so explore other rooms.
ww.hint.4_clues: You have 4 Clues! Click a player's Statue in the front courtyard to accuse them.
ww.hint.lose_clues: After a Trial, the accuser loses all Clues and everyone else keeps a maximum of 2.

ww.hint.offhand_attention: Press [%s] to get someone's attention. Same range rules as chat.
ww.hint.game_start_1a: Welcome to the Masquerade! Messages like this give helpful hints. You can turn them off in settings.
ww.hint.game_start_1b: Each symphony changes which Roles can appear. Check your Logbook for the full list.
ww.hint.game_start_2: Top left: your Alignment, Role Type and Role, with your ability below. Normally only 1 of each Role is in play.
ww.hint.game_start_3a:
Your hotbar:
1. Logbook: all the info you need. Check it often!
2. Amulet: activates your ability when the eye is fully visible.
3. Quill: sends chat messages.
ww.hint.game_start_3b:
Your hotbar:
1. Logbook: all the info you need. Check it often!
2. Amulet: for active abilities only. Ignore it.
3. Quill: sends chat messages.
ww.hint.game_start_4: Good wins when the Demon is dead. Evil wins when there is only 1 Good player left.
ww.hint.game_start_5: Good luck! If you're ever confused, check your Logbook.
ww.hint.trial_called: A Trial has begun! Use the Gavel in your middle slot to vote to execute the accused. Votes are (usually) anonymous.
ww.hint.closed_door: Doors change every game. Rooms with closed doors aren't in play.
ww.hint.death: Lightning means someone died! Dead players can still talk, but can't use abilities, accuse, or vote.
ww.hint.demon_kill_1: Long games favor Good, who gather more information. Use your ability often!
ww.hint.demon_kill_2: If the Demon doesn't kill, games drag on and Good usually wins. Use your ability!
ww.hint.demon_kill_3: It's been a while! Use the Amulet in your middle slot to kill a player.
ww.hint.demon_survived: Players can survive an attack, e.g. when protected by a Monk or if they're the Soldier.
ww.hint.voted_active: You are now voting for execution!
ww.script.1.name: Ouverture
ww.script.1.description: A clear, welcoming score for those new to the stage. Roles are straightforward, and evil moves in predictable rhythms.
ww.script.2.name: Danse Macabre
ww.script.2.description: A frantic waltz where the body count climbs fast. Demons strike swiftly, though every blade has its flaw.
ww.script.3.name: Clair de Lune
ww.script.3.description: Nothing is quite what it seems in the pale light. Roles and allegiances shift and the melody changes key before you've learned the words.
ww.script.4.name: Dies irae
ww.script.4.description: Words can be forged, faces can lie, and the evil team must become masters of theatre to survive. Trust what you see even less than what you're told.

ww.role.alchemist.ability_strategy.2: %s The %s%s whose ability you gained is not in the game. This is valuable information!
ww.role.alchemist.ability_strategy.3: %s You have the %s ability and %s%s the %s. The %s is executed, but the game does not end.
ww.role.alchemist.ability_strategy.4: %s You have the %s ability and %s%s the %s. The %s dies and %s%s wins.
ww.role.archivist.ability_strategy.1: %s If a player claims a role you've seen, they are likely telling the truth.
ww.role.archivist.ability_strategy.2: %s If you learn an %s%s role, tell your team! Knowing what you're up against is half the battle.
ww.role.archivist.ability_strategy.3: %s Confirming a %s%s player with your information may make them a target for the %s%s. Don't reveal powerful roles too early!

ww.role.artist.ability_strategy.2: %s If you find an %s%s player you suddenly have very useful information about their neighbours.
ww.role.artist.ability_strategy.3: %s The %s, %s%s and %s%s are neighbouring. You learn a "2".

ww.role.bailiff.ability_strategy.2: %s %s%s doesn't come only from a guilty trial verdict, but also from roles such as %s and %s.

ww.role.baker.ability_strategy.2: %s You can %s%s one of your neighbours. If they survive %s%s both neighbours are likely %s%s!
ww.role.baker.ability_strategy.3: %s Your neighbouring %s%s are the %s and %s. The %s is executed and dies. The new neighbour is the %s. The %s%s attacks the %s but they survive.

ww.role.balloonist.ability_confusion.1: The player you learn will share a role type with the last learned player.

ww.role.balloonist.ability_strategy.2: %s Try to identify the %s%s(s) in your game. If you learn two non-%s%s in a row, you've found a %s%s or %s%s!
ww.role.balloonist.ability_strategy.3: %s Pig and Lion are %s%s, while Fox is a %s%s. You first learn "Pig" then "Fox", and then "Lion".

ww.role.spy.ability_strategy.3: %s Sometimes %s%s a fellow %s%s player can be even more helpful in co-ordination.
ww.role.spy.ability_strategy.4: %s You've %s%s Bee. Bee talks to Frog in another room. You hear everything that is being said.
ww.role.usurper.ability_description.1: When the %s%s dies, if there are 5+ alive players, become the %s%s.
ww.role.usurper.ability_extended_info.1: Living player count is counted *after* the %s%s dies.
ww.role.usurper.ability_strategy.1: %s Don't be suspicious! It's not very useful to turn into the %s%s only to be immediately %s%s.
ww.role.usurper.ability_strategy.2: %s Work with your %s%s on a strategy. Maybe you can push on them being %s%s to earn trust. Or double claim a role. One of you must be telling the truth, right?
ww.role.usurper.ability_strategy.3: %s There are 7 players alive. The %s%s dies, you become the %s%s.
ww.role.balor.ability_description.1: The first player in Line of Sight dies.
ww.role.balor.ability_extended_info.1: If your Sight doesn't hit anyone, it will have a short %s%s.
ww.role.balor.ability_confusion.1: The player in your Sight does not die, but your ability does go on full %s%s.
ww.role.balor.ability_strategy.1: %s Your ability has an infinite range. Make use of it!
ww.role.balor.ability_strategy.2: %s Mix up your ranges. Players might expect you to always shoot from a long distance, and not suspect the %s to be right in front of them.
ww.role.balor.ability_strategy.3: %s You use your ability while looking at Fish. They die.
ww.role.doppelganger.ability_description: %s%s a player. They die. Or, at any point,
%s%s a player to copy their appearance, and switch back when a %s%s is called.
ww.role.doppelganger.ability_extended_in: %s%s only applies to the %s%s part of your ability.
ww.role.doppelganger.ability_confusion.1: Nothing happens to your %s%s player and you can't change appearance. You will still switch back when a %s%s is called.
ww.role.doppelganger.ability_strategy.1: %s When players realize it's a %s they will start to look for players they never see. Spend some time as your true self to avoid too much suspicion.
ww.role.doppelganger.ability_strategy.2: %s You can imitate trusted dead players. Spread some misinformation!
ww.role.doppelganger.ability_strategy.3: %s You use your ability while looking at Fish. They die.
ww.role.doppelganger.ability_strategy.4: %s You use your ability without looking at anyone, then pick "Fox". You now look like Fox.
ww.role.dynasty.ability_description.1: %s%s a player. They become the %s%s %s and you die.
ww.role.dynasty.ability_confusion.1: Nothing happens when you %s%s a player. Your ability will go on %s%s.
ww.role.dynasty.ability_strategy.1: %s You are very vulnerable without %s%s. Swap as often as you can.
ww.role.dynasty.ability_strategy.2: %s Find trusted players, but not too trusted. Once players figure out it's a %s game they will start to try and guess who you'd pick.
ww.role.dynasty.ability_strategy.3: %s In a %s game most of the %s%s players will be %s%s, so sow some chaos. Your living %s%s will need it.
ww.role.dynasty.ability_strategy.4: %s You %s%s Frog. They become the %s%s %s and you die. Later Frog %s%s the %s. Nothing happens.
ww.role.gorgon.ability_description.1: %s%s a player to Paralyze them. You don't see other %s. Only 1 can win.
ww.role.gorgon.ability_description.2: The first dead %s becomes %s%s. [1 %s%s is a %s]
ww.role.gorgon.ability_extended_info.1: Paralyzed players cannot move, talk or use their ability. They become %s%s when the next %s%s starts.
ww.role.gorgon.ability_strategy.1: %s Your biggest threat is the other %s. Focus on figuring out who it is and %s%s them before they get you.
ww.role.gorgon.ability_strategy.2: %s Don't %s%s the other %s too early. Their additional %s%s power is very useful.
ww.role.gorgon.ability_strategy.3: %s Convince your %s%s you're the better %s. They know who the other one is and might reveal it to you.
ww.role.gorgon.ability_strategy.4: %s You %s%s Rat. They become unable to act, and die after the next %s%s. Then the other %s %s%s you. After the next %s%s you die and turn %s%s.
ww.role.grim.ability_confusion.1: %s%s players do not die after %s%s if you are %s%s. They still lose %s%s.
ww.role.grim.ability_strategy.1: %s Try to delay %s%s so you can get multiple %s%s set up.
ww.role.grim.ability_strategy.2: %s Players will try to recall who they were with before the last %s%s, so try to %s%s players in larger groups.
ww.role.grim.ability_strategy.3: %s You need to survive the last %s%s for your %s%s to trigger. Don't celebrate too early.
ww.role.grim.ability_strategy.4: %s You %s%s Horse. During the next %s%s it is revealed Horse is %s%s. After the %s%s Horse survives since they were protected by the %s. They are no longer %s%s.
ww.role.legion.ability_description.1: %s%s players can only be %s%s if at least 1 %s%s player votes.
ww.role.legion.ability_description.2: Periodically, a player in the majority dies. [most players are %s]
ww.role.legion.ability_extended_info.1: The majority is the %s%s with the most living players, in case of a tie an %s%s player will die.
ww.role.legion.ability_strategy.1: %s Don't be too quick to use a bluff. The rest of your %s might need them.
ww.role.legion.ability_strategy.2: %s Try not to vote unless you're sure a %s%s player votes. Failed %s%s might clue the %s%s team into it being a %s game.
ww.role.legion.ability_strategy.3: %s Once it becomes obvious it's a %s game, you want to have at least 1 %s%s player thinking you're on their side.
ww.role.legion.ability_strategy.4: %s Rat is %s%s and receives enough votes, but because no %s%s player voted nothing happens.
ww.role.naga.ability_description.1: At any point, leave your body to control a small deadly snake until you %s%s your body
ww.role.naga.ability_description.2: or it takes damage. If you %s%s a player as a snake, they are %s%s.
ww.role.naga.ability_extended_info.1: Your %s%s applies once you %s%s a player and is not affected by turning into or returning from being a snake.
ww.role.naga.ability_confusion.1: You cannot turn into a snake or %s%s players, but you can return to your body.
ww.role.naga.ability_strategy.1: %s Try to hide in snake form. Biting a player without them noticing is always better than having to lose your pursuers.
ww.role.naga.ability_strategy.2: %s You immediately return to your body when something happens to it. Have a %s%s punch your body after a while to return easily.
ww.role.naga.ability_strategy.3: %s Don't lead players to your body! It's a better idea to run around and try to lose them.
ww.role.naga.ability_strategy.4: %s You turn into a snake and bite Rat. During the next %s%s it is revealed Rat is %s%s. After the %s%s Rat dies.
ww.role.nocturne.ability_description.2: The first player you %s%s during this time dies.
ww.role.nocturne.ability_confusion.1: Players will not become Blind, and you cannot %s%s.
ww.role.nocturne.ability_strategy.1: %s Blindness is much more effective inside than outside. Make sure no-one can make out your silhouette.
ww.role.nocturne.ability_strategy.2: %s 10 seconds is longer than it seems. You can get quite far in that time.
ww.role.nocturne.ability_strategy.3: %s Be wary of the %s. You don't Blind them and it would be a shame if they see you %s%s someone in front of them.
ww.role.nocturne.ability_strategy.4: %s You activate your ability and %s%s Frog. They die. You return to where you activated your ability before the blindness ends.
ww.role.ojo.ability_description.1: %s%s a role. The player with that role dies.
ww.role.ojo.ability_description.2: If no such player exists, another %s%s player might die.
ww.role.ojo.ability_extended_info.1: The chance of an %s%s player dying increases with every wrong guess.
ww.role.ojo.ability_confusion.1: No-one dies after you %s%s a role.
ww.role.ojo.ability_strategy.1: %s Try not to miss a guess too often. You will need your %s%s to win.
ww.role.ojo.ability_strategy.2: %s Don't wait too long with guessing. The more time the %s%s team has the less chance you'll have.
ww.role.ojo.ability_strategy.3: %s Keep track of the roles you've already guessed. It would be a shame to guess them again.
ww.role.ojo.ability_strategy.4: %s You %s%s %s. No player has that role and nothing happens. You then %s%s %s. Rat is the %s and dies.
ww.role.parasite.ability_description.1: %s%s a player to kill them. Start with a Host, who is %s%s.
ww.role.parasite.ability_description.2: You die if and only if your Host does. You always vote to %s%s them in %s%s.
ww.role.parasite.ability_extended_info.1: Your Host is always a %s%s player.
ww.role.parasite.ability_confusion.1: You cannot %s%s, and can die even if your Host is alive.
ww.role.parasite.ability_strategy.1: %s You're the only %s%s that doesn't have to worry about being %s%s. As long as your Host is alive you'll be too.
ww.role.parasite.ability_strategy.2: %s Make sure to tell your %s%s who the Host is. You don't want them to %s%s your Host and accidentally end you as well.
ww.role.parasite.ability_strategy.3: %s You are %s%s and %s%s, but do not die since your Host is alive. Later your Host is %s%s. You die and %s%s wins.
ww.role.pookah.ability_description.1: %s%s a player. They are %s%s. Your previous %s%s dies.
ww.role.pookah.ability_extended_info.1: The previous %s%s is still %s%s when they die, meaning roles like %s get false information.
ww.role.pookah.ability_confusion.1: Your %s%s is not %s%s and does not die when you %s%s a new player.
ww.role.pookah.ability_strategy.1: %s You can take away the main strength of the %s%s team: information. Try to hide that you are the %s to keep the %s%s team in the dark as long as possible.
ww.role.pookah.ability_strategy.2: %s Target talkative players. They can spread some %s%s misinformation for you before they die.
ww.role.pookah.ability_strategy.3: %s You %s%s the %s, then %s%s the %s. The %s does not die since they are immune from your %s%s. Later you %s%s the %s. The %s dies and receives false information.
ww.role.raze.ability_description.1: Drop a bomb that only %s%s players can see. After 15 seconds, it explodes,
ww.role.raze.ability_description.2: %s%s all other nearby players. If you miss, %s%s is halved.
ww.role.raze.ability_extended_info.1: The bomb is visible to all players nearby after it explodes.
ww.role.raze.ability_confusion.1: Your bomb explosion does not %s%s anyone.
ww.role.raze.ability_strategy.1: %s You are immune to your bomb, but your %s%s are not! Even if they can see it, try to be careful.
ww.role.raze.ability_strategy.2: %s You have time after setting the bomb. Walk away calmly instead of running to avoid suspicion.
ww.role.raze.ability_strategy.3: %s You place the bomb. 15 seconds later it explodes and hits Frog, Bee, Mosquito, and Owl. All but Owl die, since Owl was the %s.
ww.role.revenant.ability_description.1: %s%s a player. Possess them. Your last Possession dies.
ww.role.revenant.ability_extended_info.1: Possessed players spectate you but cannot move, talk or use their ability.
ww.role.revenant.ability_confusion.1: Nothing happens when you %s%s a player.
ww.role.revenant.ability_strategy.1: %s Make sure to act like the player you Possess or you might be found out!
ww.role.revenant.ability_strategy.2: %s Your Possession can see anything you can. Don't talk to your %s%s or they'll be sold out once you swap players.
ww.role.revenant.ability_strategy.3: %s You %s%s Rat and turn into them. Later you %s%s Owl, Rat dies and you become Owl.
ww.role.siren.ability_description.1: Your first chat message is not sent to other players.
ww.role.siren.ability_description.2: Resend your first chat message. A random %s%s player who hears it is %s%s.
ww.role.siren.ability_confusion.1: No player is %s%s when you send the message.
ww.role.siren.ability_strategy.1: %s Your first message is hidden from other players so don't worry about them hearing it.
ww.role.siren.ability_strategy.2: %s Make your message something you can say at any point, you can't change it later.
ww.role.siren.ability_strategy.3: %s Your first message is "hi". You use your ability and players around you see you send "hi". A %s%s player that heard it is %s%s and dies after the next %s%s.
ww.role.wraith.ability_description.1: %s%s a living non-Haunted player. They are Haunted and learn this.
ww.role.wraith.ability_description.2: If you %s%s yourself all Haunted players die instead.
ww.role.wraith.ability_extended_info.1: Haunting has no effect in itself.
ww.role.wraith.ability_extended_info.2: %s%s happen in the order players were %s%s.
ww.role.wraith.ability_confusion.1: Nothing happens when you %s%s a player.
ww.role.wraith.ability_strategy.1: %s Leaving players alive means the %s%s team will have to pick between more players to %s%s. Don't %s%s if you don't need to.
ww.role.wraith.ability_strategy.2: %s Lie about being Haunted at some point. It would be suspicious if you don't get picked at all.
ww.role.wraith.ability_strategy.3: %s You %s%s Mantis, they learn they are Haunted. Later you %s%s yourself, Mantis dies.
ww.role.zenith.ability_confusion.1: The furthest %s%s player does not die (and neither does the closest).
ww.role.zenith.ability_strategy.1: %s Your ability skips over your %s%s. You can use this to confuse who was closest to the player that died.
ww.role.zenith.ability_strategy.2: %s Try to get %s%s through walls or ceilings to make it harder to track you down.
ww.role.zenith.ability_strategy.3: %s Your %s%s method is very simple but effective. Lean into that and try to get frequent, clean %s%s.
ww.role.zenith.ability_strategy.4: %s You use your ability. The closet player is Rat, but since they are the %s and register as %s%s the next closest player dies instead.
